Write a short plain-text topic title for this genomics workbench conversation.
Return only the title, at most 60 characters. Describe the activity, not patient identities.
Do not include identifiers, privacy tokens, query handles, quotes, or Markdown.
Prepare somatic-snv for specimens from [PT_1] received in the past week. I will give you my preferred parameters after I see the draft.

I've prepared the draft.

**Specimens** — the query for [PT_1] over the last 7 days returned 3 specimens; the published table **"Specimens from [PT_1], last 7 days"** lists them (specimen, type, purity, received). Because somatic calling needs both tumor and normal from the same patient, I queried all specimen kinds rather than filtering, so both roles are included in that selection.

**Draft** — the published form **"Somatic variant calling"** (draft-0001, version 1) is bound to that specimen selection with the app defaults:
- min_vaf = 0.05
- min_depth = 20

Validation returned no issues, so nothing is missing at this point. Status is *editing* — it has not been submitted and no job has been started. Only the human **Confirm** control can submit the reviewed content hash.

Send me your preferred parameters (e.g. min_vaf, min_depth) and I'll patch this same draft; the form will republish with the new version and hash for you to review.
